notes.title: Demo Update News!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45089358/cb1b5905f553e1eb2e28c92b921bb6a80f12a141.png

Hello folks! 🤠

We've been cookin' up something sweet, and it’s time to share it - our demo update is here!


 You can now unlock cosmetics and customize your look. Want to run puzzles in a top hat and boots? Go wild! Maybe even post your weirdest cosmetic combos - we’d love to see what you all come up with 🤪👚
 We’ve also balanced a bunch of levels and added brand-new ones, so whether you're just starting out or already lasso-deep, there’s something fresh to test your puzzle skills. 🤔🧩
 Our tutorials now feature video explanations, making it easier than ever to pick up the ropes (literally). Perfect for both newcomers and returning pros. 📚✨
 And of course - bug fixes and quality-of-life updates to make everything smoother than a buttered-up bread loaf. 🐜🍞


Let us know what you think, and as always...

Pigs out! 🐖

notes.title: Hogtie Demo - NextFest October 2024 Update!
notes.notes:
Hey cowboys! 🤠

We are happy to announce that Hogtie is joining NextFest October 2024!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45089358/42f4c8720d022f9079212894b336079da7063973.jpg
Hogtie Demo will also be updated alongside, with a brand new biome and a bunch of new levels, try them out! 

Here is a list of changes we did for the new demo:


 Added the Winter Biome: Play in this new world, filled with new puzzles and mechanics!

 New Desert Biome Levels: Added new levels and updated old ones 

 Desert tiles: Desert biome should have different colored tiles now

 Environment update: Added cool new stuff around the maps


Enjoy the demo update and make sure to let us know how you feel about the new biome! Your feedback is extremely important to us.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45089358/7a760cc05f57dc81838aeec087c6c185ab5691f4.png

Also, if you want to have a sneakpeek at our next biome, you might wanna play the last level of the Winter biome!

Pigs out! 🐷
